Luang Prabang

Luang Prabang 2

  1. Must see · Luang Prabang

    Luang Prabang Old Town (Wat Xieng Thong)

    The UNESCO-listed royal town where Lao and French-colonial architecture meet, crowned by the 1560 Wat Xieng Thong and the dawn alms-giving.

    Look for UNESCO heritage town

    Luang Prabang peninsula, Laos

    Recommended by UNESCO World Heritage, Wikipedia

  2. Must see · Luang Prabang

    Kuang Si Falls

    Turquoise multi-tiered travertine waterfalls in the jungle — Luang Prabang's signature natural excursion.

    Look for Waterfall

    ~29 km south of Luang Prabang, Laos

    Recommended by Wander-Lush (Emily Lush), Wikipedia
